parts.model_overhangs_review: The actual final Mark2 lid emits five model-rooted supports, each with one explicit roof island: suction-chain, discharge-chain and fluid-14 tie tunnels plus fluid-18 and water-3 side-anchor windows. The short water-3 body has measured zero build-up, retained as a topology reading rather than a cleanup rating. All 3936 actual support roads are assigned exactly once; their full-width/full-layer-height conservative envelopes pass 15 native initial/lift/withdrawal checks against the complete lid. Flat bearing roofs, the 0.25 mm floor-relief lips, full post/rib stock and all valve/pump mounting surfaces are preserved. The independent exact model-path proof covers all 241 layers / 785 section components; physical support removal effort, finish and assembly fit remain unmeasured.
